title: Seed protector (cracker stopper)
description: By removing a configurable percantage of structures, we should be able to stop seed cracking.
body:
By stopping the generation of a % of structures, we are able to STOP seed cracking.
This is really shitty, but it seems to work? has a config.json where you can specify which stuctures are or arent counted. along with changing the percantage (higher is more secure)
